title: Check: Area of Rectangles and Triangles (B)

questions.stem: A rectangular garden is $15\text{ m}$ long and $9\text{ m}$ wide. A triangular flower bed with base $6\text{ m}$ and height $4\text{ m}$ is inside it. What is the remaining area of the garden?
questions.explanation: Garden area $= 15 \times 9 = 135\text{ m}^2$. Flower bed area $= \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 4 = 12\text{ m}^2$. Remaining area $= 135 - 12 = 123\text{ m}^2$.
